# Trope Catalog Index

The living catalog currently contains 70 compact entries. Load only the file matching the design problem.

| Catalog                                          | Entries | Use for                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ------: | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| [CHARACTER_TROPES.md](CHARACTER_TROPES.md)       |      21 | Individual character surfaces and appeal engines            |
| [RELATIONSHIP_TROPES.md](RELATIONSHIP_TROPES.md) |      16 | Pair, group, and bonded-object dynamics                     |
| [MEDIA_CONVENTIONS.md](MEDIA_CONVENTIONS.md)     |      13 | Plot, route, team, transformation, and franchise structures |
| [SPECIES_ROLE_TROPES.md](SPECIES_ROLE_TROPES.md) |      20 | Species, vocation, and social-position surface archetypes   |

Every entry contains:

- **Expected beats**
- **Straight quality bar**
- **Proven subversions**
- **Degradation patterns**

Use `core-craft` to declare straight or subverted mode and set the familiarity budget before loading entries.
